summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 14 flux

Scores calculables: 10/14 (flux sans score: 4)
Score moyen des flux calculables: 0.474 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.677, Score minimum: 0.316

TOP 3 FLUX SELON L'ANCIEN SCORE PROXY (NON DECISIONNEL CSD):
  1. Abs_magnetization (score: 0.677)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.37 vs bruit blanc 0.11
     - Hurst max: 0.642, Pente FFT: -0.554
  2. Abs_magnetization_shuffled (score: 0.657)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.36 vs bruit blanc 0.11
     - Hurst max: 0.880, Pente FFT: -0.266
  3. M_squared (score: 0.608)
     - Q5 ratio: 0.29 vs bruit blanc 0.11
     - Hurst max: 0.652, Pente FFT: -0.362

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. Noise_flux (score: 0.408)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.735
  2. MC_Update (score: 0.318)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.058
  3. Cluster_fraction (score: 0.316)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.534
